bar_centroid_meaning: 31 mm clear to longitudinal bar + 4 mm radius
31 mm clear to stirrup + 8 mm stirrup + 4 mm radius
bounded_sensitivity_plan.concrete_range_meaning: Table 3 mean +/- reported 2.0 spread and section 3.1 conflicting mean; not a confidence interval, not cylinder strengths
bounded_sensitivity_plan.execution_state: NOT_RUN; parent proposal required before any solver
held_fixed_but_unresolved: bar coordinates at top and stirrup layout
bounded_sensitivity_plan.no_arbitrary_ranges: Unreported steel scatter, friction and conversion factors have no evidential numeric bounds. They remain unknown; this finite matrix is not a complete uncertainty envelope.
bounded_sensitivity_plan.stop_condition: If any indispensable held-fixed input remains unresolved, do not run this matrix. Deliver conditional analytic effects and HOLD.

early_secant_interpretation: Operational early-response slope only; seating/cracking can affect it, not a measured material modulus.

metrics.checkpoint_load: signed kN difference and absolute relative discrepancy for every supported target; undefined near zero is reported, not omitted
metrics.early_secant: K=(P(0.15)-P(0.05))/0.10; signed relative discrepancy if measurement K != 0
metrics.failure_policy: Every attempted case/target remains in denominator; stop on material inadmissibility; nonconverged/missing/unsupported intervals never interpolated from predictions, never counted as zero error
metrics.increment_sensitivity: At common targets report |P_base-P_refined| and max difference divided by measured diagnostic load range; report all nonconverged targets
metrics.numerical_diagnostic_threshold: <=0.02 normalized maximum difference between base/refined paths; analyst-selected research criterion, not source-derived physical tolerance
metrics.path: RMSE and maximum absolute discrepancy over the 0.05-mm grid from 0.05 to 10 mm; NRMSE denominator = max measured selected load minus min; report count and coverage
metrics.physical_acceptance_blocker: No calibrated measurement uncertainty or intended-use tolerance established; physical PASS cannot be issued.
metrics.prohibited: selecting best parameter after score, tuning to these measurements, using load-step split as independent holdout

observable_equations.coordinate_units: solver m, MN; measurement mm, kN; confirm each executable contract before use
observable_equations.displacement_down_positive: delta_mm = -1000 * (v_mid - 0.5*(v_left_support+v_right_support)); model bridge reference is conditional on the physical support-reference setup
observable_equations.force_if_per_nose: load_kN = 500*(R_left_y+R_right_y - initial_vertical_reaction_sum_MN); each equal nose = workbook load
observable_equations.force_if_total_actuator: load_kN = 1000*(R_left_y+R_right_y - initial_vertical_reaction_sum_MN); each equal nose = total/2 only if spreader symmetry and applied pattern confirmed
observable_equations.unresolved: load-cell channel definition, tare/dead-load treatment, horizontal restraints, zero/reference offset, physical reference-frame compliance

proposed_target_paths.beyond_10mm: retained measurement checkpoints only; no full-path model adequacy claim
proposed_target_paths.mesh: must include exact support, load and midpoint stations; refinement must preserve stations; pin actual mesh, section fibers, integration and all solver tolerances before solve
proposed_target_paths.ordering: sort the independently specified solver target grid numerically; never sort observations
proposed_target_paths.purpose: diagnostic retrospective comparison only after indispensable mappings resolve and parent approves dispatch
proposed_target_paths.start: zero state; no fabricated negative or shifted experimental origin
